verdict.rationale: The docs show official code samples for Python (`tbl.create_fts_index`, `to_pydantic`), TypeScript/JavaScript (`await table.search(...).toArray()`, `new arrow.Field`) and Rust (`impl EmbeddingFunction`). They also state 'multi-language SDK support' and that API keys work 'in every SDK', and a community user confirms building with the npm package. Nothing in the pack shows official Go or Java SDKs, so only half of the named languages are evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of official Go and Java SDKs, an explicit SDK/language support matrix.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in the major languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)
